title: "assessing-athletes"
format: html
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---




```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(brms)


set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(athlete = paste0("a", 1:10), 
                pre = rnorm(10, 60, 5), 
                post = rnorm(10, 61, 5)) |> 
  print()

d2 <- d |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pre, post), 
               names_to = "time") |> 
  mutate(time = factor(time, levels = c("pre", "post"))) |> 
  print()

default_prior(value ~ time + (time|athlete), 
         data = d2)



m <- brm(value ~ time + (time|athlete), 
         data = d2, 
         prior = c(prior(normal(60, 10), class = "Intercept"), 
                   prior(normal(0, 6), class = "b", coef = "timepost"), 
                   prior(normal(0, 6), class ="sd")))

summary(m)

```
